summary: Deprecations: yes/no for follow_redirects in uri and url lookup, several yum_repository parameters (keepcache, async, gpgcakey and more), cisco.asa and ibm.qradar leaving ee-supported, ansible.controller/hub/eda collections to be replaced by ansible.platform after 2.6, the Lightspeed code bot (retired Dec 31, 2025) and the ServiceNow notification service.
questions: Can I still use yes for follow_redirects in the uri module?

answer_card.title: Notable deprecations in AAP 2.6
answer_card.answer_md:
- `uri` module / `url` lookup: `yes`/`no` for `follow_redirects`
- `yum_repository`: `keepcache`, `async`, `deltarpm_metadata_percentage`, `gpgcakey`, `http_caching`, `keepalive`, `metadata_expire_filter`, `mirrorlist_expire`, `protect`, `ssl_check_cert_permissions`, `ui_repoid_vars`
- `cisco.asa`, `ibm.qradar` removed from ee-supported
- `ansible.controller`, `ansible.hub`, `ansible.eda` → replaced by `ansible.platform` after 2.6
- Lightspeed code bot retired December 31, 2025
